name: Neon Prism
description: A mirrored red-and-blue tapestry narrows at its center, with two side diamonds, long red diagonal borders and small top and bottom chevrons. Red tiles are lethal until captured; blue tiles slow the player. Five pink ring bouncers begin in the upper center notch, upper-right field, right diagonal and two lower-left positions. Four cyan patrols start on the top and side rails. Start at bottom center and reveal 75%.
